sana-gmm.viewpoint: Diagnoses structural stability across Layers A (survival), B (meaning/narrative) and C (institution): where structural pressure is accumulating. It does not judge who is right or predict outcomes.
sana-gmm.description: SANA GMM — pressure balance across Layers A/B/C. Where structural pressure accumulates across Layers A/B/C — layer gaps, stress, bottleneck layer. Load when diagnosing the balance of survival, meaning and institutions in a society, organization or era (層のバランス, 構造的ストレス, GMM).
sana-gmm.short: GMM — pressure balance across Layers A/B/C

sana-rbm.viewpoint: Identifies where demand exceeds supply for critical functions (Gap = Demand − Supply). Detects overload and bottlenecks, not failure of intent; assigns no blame.
sana-rbm.description: SANA RBM — where demand exceeds capacity. Gap, shortage and bottleneck of a function. Load when overload or exhaustion is suspected in a person, team, institution or state (リソース不足, 過負荷, ボトルネック, RBM). Not before premises are aligned.

sana-cpm.viewpoint: Describes how humans process unknown variables (X) under pressure: survival compression, narrative stabilisation, exploratory simulation, and the state of architects who can hold X without substituting it.
sana-cpm.description: SANA CPM — handling unknowns under pressure. How people handle unknowns under pressure — cognitive compression, narrative substitution, enemy construction, architect states. Load for witch hunts, panics, rumours, rigid thinking, or why a group stopped exploring (認知圧縮, 物語の置換, CPM).

sana-rsm.viewpoint: Models collective systems as networks of functional roles (Decider, Architect, Integrator, Executor, Observer, Auditor) and finds failures in that network: role capture, architect isolation, succession deficit.
sana-rsm.description: SANA RSM — failures in the network of roles. Organizations and states as networks of functional roles — role capture, architect isolation, missing auditors, succession deficit. Load for institutional dysfunction, military/bureaucratic takeover, failed reformers, team role conflict (役割の失敗, 改革者の孤立, RSM).
sana-rsm.short: RSM — failures in the network of roles

sana-legitimacy-layer.viewpoint: Analyses civilizational cohesion as the alignment of Narrative Core (who we are) and Institution Core (what structure is valid); instability is the gap between them. It asks what is recognized as rightful, not who is morally correct.
sana-legitimacy-layer.description: SANA Legitimacy — narrative vs institution core. Why a community accepts a structure as valid — Narrative Core vs Institution Core, legitimacy gap, void formation. Load for revolutions, civil wars, succession crises, regime legitimacy, inherited authority (正統性, 物語と制度の乖離, Legitimacy).

sana-history-analysis.viewpoint: Reads history through structure rather than correctness: Source Trifurcation (Fact / Perception / Record), non-competitive framing, and the Thought Experiment Sandbox for marked hypotheses.
sana-history-analysis.description: SANA History — Fact/Perception/Record, sandbox. Source Trifurcation (Fact / Perception / Record), non-competitive framing, narrative function, Thought Experiment Sandbox. Load before analysing any historical event, source, inscription, image or record, and before writing hypotheses about the past (史料の三分類, 歴史分析).

sana-value-formation.viewpoint: Models how personal value hierarchies form through reward/punishment systems and community membership; Proximity Rule (Priority = Impact / Distance), trust dynamics, priority filtering. b- and c-layer are the same survival rules in different phases.
sana-value-formation.description: SANA Value Formation — proximity and priority. How a person's priorities form and why local pressure beats distant rules — Proximity Rule, trust dynamics, priority filtering, continuum of culture and institution. Load for personal conflict, peer pressure, workplace atmosphere, why someone follows local norms (価値観の形成, 近接性の法則).

sana-frameworks-index.viewpoint: Index of the SANA OS frameworks and the integration map showing how each lens feeds the others.
sana-frameworks-index.description: SANA Index and integration map of all lenses. Load when choosing which lenses to combine for an analysis, or when explaining how the frameworks relate (フレームワーク一覧, 連携図).
sana-frameworks-index.short: Index and integration map of all lenses

sana-core-specification.viewpoint: Technical specification of the SANA OS alignment engine: state machine, Δv logic, handshake and exposure gating, I/O contract. Developer reference, not a dialogue rule set.
sana-core-specification.description: SANA Core engine spec (state machine, Δv, I/O). Load when designing or reviewing a SANA OS implementation, API, workflow or agent setup (実装仕様, エンジン設計).
sana-core-specification.short: Core engine spec (state machine, Δv, I/O)

sana-review-history.viewpoint: Whether each historical statement sits where its footing allows: observation, Fact / Perception / Record, or a marked hypothesis. It does not judge whether a hypothesis is true.
sana-review-history.description: SANA Review — historical observation and reasoning. Review History SANA output: observation errors, interpretation inside observation, inference stated as Fact, proper names and dates, F/P/R displacement, copies treated as originals, unmarked hypotheses (歴史レビュー, 固有名, 年代).

sana-review-design.short: Review — designs, handoff briefs, build results
sana-review-design.viewpoint: Whether a design's premises are stated and footed, roles are separated, boundaries carry reasons, and results match the agreed brief. It does not substitute the reviewer's preferred design.
sana-review-design.description: SANA Review — designs, handoff briefs, build results. Review the Hub's plans and briefs and executors' results: unstated premises, unverified environment claims, role separation, silent fallbacks, boundaries without reasons, irreversible steps, evidence of completion (設計レビュー, 構築物レビュー).

sana-review-framework-change.short: Review — framework change: sharpened or shifted
sana-review-framework-change.viewpoint: Whether a change to a SANA skill sharpens its fixed viewpoint, extends it, or shifts it to look at something else.
sana-review-framework-change.description: SANA Review — framework change: sharpened or shifted. Review revisions of SANA skills and personas against their invariant viewpoint and the Core invariants (フレームワーク改訂, 研ぎ澄ましかズレか).

sana-friend-story.short: Story — characters, layers of the text, readings
sana-friend-story.viewpoint: How a fictional character's choices follow from their premises and the pressures of their world, and how the layers of a text — what is shown, what a character perceives, what the narration frames, what readers infer — differ.
sana-friend-story.description: SANA Story — characters, layers of the text, readings. Read novels, manga, anime, films, games, myths or the person's own fiction: spoilers and versions, shown vs perceived vs narrated vs inferred, why a character chose, world-level lenses, author vs character (物語の考察, キャラクター, 考察).
